15.en: Later on, at the time of wheat harvest, Samson took a young goat and went to visit his wife. He said, "I'm going to my wife's room." But her father would not let him go in.

15.zh: 说：我估定你是极其恨他，因此我将他给了你的陪伴。他的妹子不是比他还美丽么？你可以娶来代替他罢！
15.en: "I was so sure you thoroughly hated her," he said, "that I gave her to your friend. Isn't her younger sister more attractive? Take her instead."

15.zh: 参孙说：这回我加害于非利士人不算有罪。
15.en: Samson said to them, "This time I have a right to get even with the Philistines; I will really harm them."

15.zh: 于是参孙去捉了三百只狐狸（或译：野狗），将狐狸尾巴一对一对地捆上，将火把捆在两条尾巴中间，
15.en: So he went out and caught three hundred foxes and tied them tail to tail in pairs. He then fastened a torch to every pair of tails,

15.zh: 点著火把，就放狐狸进入非利士人站著的禾稼，将堆集的禾捆和未割的禾稼，并橄榄园尽都烧了。
15.en: lit the torches and let the foxes loose in the standing grain of the Philistines. He burned up the shocks and standing grain, together with the vineyards and olive groves.

15.zh: 非利士人说：这事是谁做的呢？有人说：是亭拿人的女婿参孙，因为他岳父将他的妻给了他的陪伴。于是非利士人上去，用火烧了妇人和他的父亲。
15.en: When the Philistines asked, "Who did this?" they were told, "Samson, the Timnite's son-in-law, because his wife was given to his friend." So the Philistines went up and burned her and her father to death.

15.zh: 参孙对非利士人说：你们既然这样行，我必向你们报仇才肯罢休。
15.en: Samson said to them, "Since you've acted like this, I won't stop until I get my revenge on you."

15.zh: 参孙就大大击杀他们，连腿带腰都砍断了。他便下去，住在以坦磐的穴内。
15.en: He attacked them viciously and slaughtered many of them. Then he went down and stayed in a cave in the rock of Etam.

15.zh: 非利士人上去安营在犹大，布散在利希。
15.en: The Philistines went up and camped in Judah, spreading out near Lehi.

15.zh: 犹大人说：你们为何上来攻击我们呢？他们说：我们上来是要捆绑参孙；他向我们怎样行，我们也要向他怎样行。
15.en: The men of Judah asked, "Why have you come to fight us?" "We have come to take Samson prisoner," they answered, "to do to him as he did to us."

15.zh: 于是有三千犹大人下到以坦磐的穴内，对参孙说：非利士人辖制我们，你不知道么？你向我们行的是甚么事呢？他回答说：他们向我怎样行，我也要向他们怎样行。
15.en: Then three thousand men from Judah went down to the cave in the rock of Etam and said to Samson, "Don't you realize that the Philistines are rulers over us? What have you done to us?" He answered, "I merely did to them what they did to me."

15.zh: 犹大人对他说：我们下来是要捆绑你，将你交在非利士人手中。参孙说：你们要向我起誓，应承你们自己不害死我。
15.en: They said to him, "We've come to tie you up and hand you over to the Philistines." Samson said, "Swear to me that you won't kill me yourselves."

15.zh: 他们说：我们断不杀你，只要将你捆绑交在非利士人手中。于是用两条新绳捆绑参孙，将他从以坦磐带上去。
15.en: "Agreed," they answered. "We will only tie you up and hand you over to them. We will not kill you." So they bound him with two new ropes and led him up from the rock.

15.zh: 参孙到了利希，非利士人都迎著喧嚷。耶和华的灵大大感动参孙，他臂上的绳就像火烧的麻一样，他的绑绳都从他手上脱落下来。
15.en: As he approached Lehi, the Philistines came toward him shouting. The Spirit of the LORD came upon him in power. The ropes on his arms became like charred flax, and the bindings dropped from his hands.

15.zh: 他见一块未干的驴腮骨，就伸手拾起来，用以击杀一千人。
15.en: Finding a fresh jawbone of a donkey, he grabbed it and struck down a thousand men.

15.zh: 参孙说：我用驴恉骨杀人成堆，用驴腮骨杀了一千人。
15.en: Then Samson said, "With a donkey's jawbone I have made donkeys of them. With a donkey's jawbone I have killed a thousand men."

15.zh: 说完这话，就把那恉骨从手里抛出去了。那地便叫拉末利希。
15.en: When he finished speaking, he threw away the jawbone; and the place was called Ramath Lehi.

15.zh: 参孙甚觉口渴，就求告耶和华说：你既藉仆人的手施行这么大的拯救，岂可任我渴死 、 落在未受割礼的人手中呢？
15.en: Because he was very thirsty, he cried out to the LORD , "You have given your servant this great victory. Must I now die of thirst and fall into the hands of the uncircumcised?"

15.zh: 神就使利希的洼处裂开，有水从其中涌出来。参孙喝了，精神复原；因此那泉名叫隐哈歌利，那泉直到今日还在利希。
15.en: Then God opened up the hollow place in Lehi, and water came out of it. When Samson drank, his strength returned and he revived. So the spring was called En Hakkore, and it is still there in Lehi.

15.zh: 当非利士人辖制以色列人的时候，参孙作以色列的士师二十年。
15.en: Samson led Israel for twenty years in the days of the Philistines.

16.zh: 参孙到了迦萨，在那里看见一个妓女，就与他亲近。
16.en: One day Samson went to Gaza, where he saw a prostitute. He went in to spend the night with her.

16.zh: 有人告诉迦萨人说：参孙到这里来了！他们就把他团团围住，终夜在城门悄悄埋伏，说：等到天亮我们便杀他。
16.en: The people of Gaza were told, "Samson is here!" So they surrounded the place and lay in wait for him all night at the city gate. They made no move during the night, saying, "At dawn we'll kill him."

16.zh: 参孙睡到半夜，起来，将城门的门扇 、 门框 、 门闩，一齐拆下来，扛在肩上，扛到希伯仑前的山顶上。
16.en: But Samson lay there only until the middle of the night. Then he got up and took hold of the doors of the city gate, together with the two posts, and tore them loose, bar and all. He lifted them to his shoulders and carried them to the top of the hill that faces Hebron.

16.zh: 后来，参孙在梭烈谷喜爱一个妇人，名叫大利拉。
16.en: Some time later, he fell in love with a woman in the Valley of Sorek whose name was Delilah.

16.zh: 非利士人的首领上去见那妇人，对他说：求你诓哄参孙，探探他因何有这么大的力气，我们用何法能胜他，捆绑克制他。我们就每人给你一千一百舍客勒银子。
16.en: The rulers of the Philistines went to her and said, "See if you can lure him into showing you the secret of his great strength and how we can overpower him so we may tie him up and subdue him. Each one of us will give you eleven hundred shekels of silver."

16.zh: 大利拉对参孙说：求你告诉我，你因何有这么大的力气，当用何法捆绑克制你。
16.en: So Delilah said to Samson, "Tell me the secret of your great strength and how you can be tied up and subdued."

16.zh: 参孙回答说：人若用七条未干的青绳子捆绑我，我就软弱像别人一样。
16.en: Samson answered her, "If anyone ties me with seven fresh thongs that have not been dried, I'll become as weak as any other man."

16.zh: 于是非利士人的首领拿了七条未干的青绳子来，交给妇人，他就用绳子捆绑参孙。
16.en: Then the rulers of the Philistines brought her seven fresh thongs that had not been dried, and she tied him with them.

16.zh: 有人预先埋伏在妇人的内室里。妇人说：参孙哪，非利士人拿你来了！参孙就挣断绳子，如挣断经火的麻线一般。这样，他力气的根由人还是不知道。
16.en: With men hidden in the room, she called to him, "Samson, the Philistines are upon you!" But he snapped the thongs as easily as a piece of string snaps when it comes close to a flame. So the secret of his strength was not discovered.

16.zh: 大利拉对参孙说：你欺哄我，向我说谎言。现在求你告诉我当用何法捆绑你。
16.en: Then Delilah said to Samson, "You have made a fool of me; you lied to me. Come now, tell me how you can be tied."

16.zh: 参孙回答说：人若用没有使过的新绳捆绑我，我就软弱像别人一样。
16.en: He said, "If anyone ties me securely with new ropes that have never been used, I'll become as weak as any other man."

16.zh: 大利拉就用新绳捆绑他，对他说：参孙哪，非利士人拿你来了！有人预先埋伏在内室里。参孙将臂上的绳挣断了，如挣断一条线一样。
16.en: So Delilah took new ropes and tied him with them. Then, with men hidden in the room, she called to him, "Samson, the Philistines are upon you!" But he snapped the ropes off his arms as if they were threads.

16.zh: 大利拉对参孙说：你到如今还是欺哄我，向我说谎言。求你告诉我，当用何法捆绑你。参孙回答说：你若将我头上的七条发绺，与纬线同织就可以了。
16.en: Delilah then said to Samson, "Until now, you have been making a fool of me and lying to me. Tell me how you can be tied." He replied, "If you weave the seven braids of my head into the fabric on the loom and tighten it with the pin, I'll become as weak as any other man." So while he was sleeping, Delilah took the seven braids of his head, wove them into the fabric

16.zh: 于是大利拉将他的发绺与纬线同织，用橛子钉住，对他说：参孙哪，非利士人拿你来了！参孙从睡中醒来，将机上的橛子和纬线一齐都拔出来了。
16.en: and tightened it with the pin. Again she called to him, "Samson, the Philistines are upon you!" He awoke from his sleep and pulled up the pin and the loom, with the fabric.

16.zh: 大利拉对参孙说：你既不与我同心，怎么说你爱我呢？你这三次欺哄我，没有告诉我，你因何有这么大的力气。
16.en: Then she said to him, "How can you say, 'I love you,' when you won't confide in me? This is the third time you have made a fool of me and haven't told me the secret of your great strength."

16.zh: 大利拉天天用话催逼他，甚至他心里烦闷要死。
16.en: With such nagging she prodded him day after day until he was tired to death.

16.zh: 参孙就把心中所藏的都告诉了他，对他说：向来人没有用剃头刀剃我的头，因为我自出母胎就归神作拿细耳人；若剃了我的头发，我的力气就离开我，我便软弱像别人一样。
16.en: So he told her everything. "No razor has ever been used on my head," he said, "because I have been a Nazirite set apart to God since birth. If my head were shaved, my strength would leave me, and I would become as weak as any other man."

16.zh: 大利拉见他把心中所藏的都告诉了他，就打发人到非利士人的首领那里，对他们说：他已经把心中所藏的都告诉了我，请你们再上来一次。于是非利士人的首领手里拿著银子，上到妇人那里。
16.en: When Delilah saw that he had told her everything, she sent word to the rulers of the Philistines, "Come back once more; he has told me everything." So the rulers of the Philistines returned with the silver in their hands.

16.zh: 大利拉使参孙枕著他的膝睡觉，叫了一个人来剃除他头上的七条发绺。于是大利拉克制他，他的力气就离开他了。
16.en: Having put him to sleep on her lap, she called a man to shave off the seven braids of his hair, and so began to subdue him. And his strength left him.

16.zh: 大利拉说：参孙哪，非利士人拿你来了！参孙从睡中醒来，心里说：我要像前几次出去活动身体；他却不知道耶和华已经离开他了。
16.en: Then she called, "Samson, the Philistines are upon you!" He awoke from his sleep and thought, "I'll go out as before and shake myself free." But he did not know that the LORD had left him.

16.zh: 非利士人将他拿住，剜了他的眼睛，带他下到迦萨，用铜炼拘索他；他就在监里推磨。
16.en: Then the Philistines seized him, gouged out his eyes and took him down to Gaza. Binding him with bronze shackles, they set him to grinding in the prison.

16.zh: 然而他的头发被剃之后，又渐渐长起来了。
16.en: But the hair on his head began to grow again after it had been shaved.

16.zh: 非利士人的首领聚集，要给他们的神大衮献大祭，并且欢乐，因为他们说：我们的神将我们的仇敌参孙交在我们手中了。
16.en: Now the rulers of the Philistines assembled to offer a great sacrifice to Dagon their god and to celebrate, saying, "Our god has delivered Samson, our enemy, into our hands."

16.zh: 众人看见参孙，就赞美他们的神说：我们的神将毁坏我们地 、 杀害我们许多人的仇敌交在我们手中了。
16.en: When the people saw him, they praised their god, saying, "Our god has delivered our enemy into our hands, the one who laid waste our land and multiplied our slain."

16.zh: 他们正宴乐的时候，就说：叫参孙来，在我们面前戏耍戏耍。于是将参孙从监里提出来，他就在众人面前戏耍。他们使他站在两柱中间。
16.en: While they were in high spirits, they shouted, "Bring out Samson to entertain us." So they called Samson out of the prison, and he performed for them. When they stood him among the pillars,

16.zh: 参孙向拉他手的童子说：求你让我摸著托房的柱子，我要靠一靠。
16.en: Samson said to the servant who held his hand, "Put me where I can feel the pillars that support the temple, so that I may lean against them."

16.zh: 那时房内充满男女，非利士人的众首领也都在那里。房的平顶上约有三千男女观看参孙戏耍。
16.en: Now the temple was crowded with men and women; all the rulers of the Philistines were there, and on the roof were about three thousand men and women watching Samson perform.

16.zh: 参孙求告耶和华说：主耶和华啊，求你眷念我。神啊，求你赐我这一次的力量，使我在非利士人身上报那剜我双眼的仇。
16.en: Then Samson prayed to the LORD , "O Sovereign LORD , remember me. O God, please strengthen me just once more, and let me with one blow get revenge on the Philistines for my two eyes."

16.zh: 参孙就抱住托房的那两根柱子：左手抱一根，右手抱一根，
16.en: Then Samson reached toward the two central pillars on which the temple stood. Bracing himself against them, his right hand on the one and his left hand on the other,

16.zh: 说：我情愿与非利士人同死！就尽力屈身，房子倒塌，压住首领和房内的众人。这样，参孙死时所杀的人比活著所杀的还多。
16.en: Samson said, "Let me die with the Philistines!" Then he pushed with all his might, and down came the temple on the rulers and all the people in it. Thus he killed many more when he died than while he lived.

16.zh: 参孙的弟兄和他父的全家都下去取他的尸首，抬上来葬在琐拉和以实陶中间，在他父玛挪亚的坟墓里。参孙作以色列的士师二十年。
16.en: Then his brothers and his father's whole family went down to get him. They brought him back and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the tomb of Manoah his father. He had led Israel twenty years.

17.zh: 以法莲山地有一个人名叫米迦。
17.en: Now a man named Micah from thehill country of Ephraim

17.zh: 他对母亲说：你那一千一百舍客勒银子被人拿去，你因此咒诅，并且告诉了我。看哪，这银子在我这里，是我拿去了。他母亲说：我儿啊，愿耶和华赐福与你！
17.en: said to his mother, "The eleven hundred shekels of silver that were taken from you and about which I heard you utter a curse-I have that silver with me; I took it." Then his mother said, "The LORD bless you, my son!"

17.zh: 米迦就把这一千一百舍客勒银子还他母亲。他母亲说：我分出这银子来为你献给耶和华，好雕刻一个像，铸成一个像。现在我还是交给你。
17.en: When he returned the eleven hundred shekels of silver to his mother, she said, "I solemnly consecrate my silver to the LORD for my son to make a carved image and a cast idol. I will give it back to you."

17.zh: 米迦将银子还他母亲，他母亲将二百舍客勒银子交给银匠，雕刻一个像，铸成一个像，安置在米迦的屋内。
17.en: So he returned the silver to his mother, and she took two hundred shekels of silver and gave them to a silversmith, who made them into the image and the idol. And they were put in Micah's house.

17.zh: 这米迦有了神堂，又制造以弗得和家中的神像，分派他一个儿子作祭司。
17.en: Now this man Micah had a shrine, and he made an ephod and some idols and installed one of his sons as his priest.

17.zh: 那时以色列中没有王，各人任意而行。
17.en: In those days Israel had no king; everyone did as he saw fit.

17.zh: 犹大的伯利恒有一个少年人，是犹大族的利未人，他在那里寄居。
17.en: A young Levite from Bethlehem in Judah, who had been living within the clan of Judah,

17.zh: 这人离开犹大的伯利恒城，要找一个可住的地方。行路的时候，到了以法莲山地，走到米迦的家。
17.en: left that town in search of some other place to stay. On his way he came to Micah's house in the hill country of Ephraim.

17.zh: 米迦问他说：你从哪里来？他回答说：从犹大的伯利恒来。我是利未人，要找一个可住的地方。
17.en: Micah asked him, "Where are you from?" "I'm a Levite from Bethlehem in Judah," he said, "and I'm looking for a place to stay."

17.zh: 米迦说：你可以住在我这里，我以你为父 、 为祭司。我每年给你十舍客勒银子，一套衣服和度日的食物。利未人就进了他的家。
17.en: Then Micah said to him, "Live with me and be my father and priest, and I'll give you ten shekels of silver a year, your clothes and your food."

17.zh: 利未人情愿与那人同住；那人看这少年人如自己的儿子一样。
17.en: So the Levite agreed to live with him, and the young man was to him like one of his sons.

17.zh: 米迦分派这少年的利未人作祭司，他就住在米迦的家里。
17.en: Then Micah installed the Levite, and the young man became his priest and lived in his house.

17.zh: 米迦说：现在我知道耶和华必赐福与我，因我有一个利未人作祭司。
17.en: And Micah said, "Now I know that the LORD will be good to me, since this Levite has become my priest."

18.zh: 那时，以色列中没有王。但支派的人仍是寻地居住；因为到那日子，他们还没有在以色列支派中得地为业。
18.en: In those days Israel had no king. And in those days the tribe of the Danites was seeking a place of their own where they might settle, because they had not yet come into an inheritance among the tribes of Israel.

18.zh: 但人从琐拉和以实陶打发本族中的五个勇士，去仔细窥探那地，吩咐他们说：你们去窥探那地。他们来到以法莲山地，进了米迦的住宅，就在那里住宿。
18.en: So the Danites sent five warriors from Zorah and Eshtaol to spy out the land and explore it. These men represented all their clans. They told them, "Go, explore the land." The men entered the hill country of Ephraim and came to the house of Micah, where they spent the night.

18.zh: 他们临近米迦的住宅，听出那少年利未人的口音来，就进去问他说：谁领你到这里来？你在这里做甚么？你在这里得甚么？
18.en: When they were near Micah's house, they recognized the voice of the young Levite; so they turned in there and asked him, "Who brought you here? What are you doing in this place? Why are you here?"

18.zh: 他回答说：米迦待我如此如此，请我作祭司。
18.en: He told them what Micah had done for him, and said, "He has hired me and I am his priest."

18.zh: 他们对他说：请你求问神，使我们知道所行的道路通达不通达。
18.en: Then they said to him, "Please inquire of God to learn whether our journey will be successful."

18.zh: 祭司对他们说：你们可以平平安安地去，你们所行的道路是在耶和华面前的。
18.en: The priest answered them, "Go in peace. Your journey has the LORD 's approval."

18.zh: 五人就走了，来到拉亿，见那里的民安居无虑，如同西顿人安居一样。在那地没有人掌权扰乱他们；他们离西顿人也远，与别人没有来往。
18.en: So the five men left and came to Laish, where they saw that the people were living in safety, like the Sidonians, unsuspecting and secure. And since their land lacked nothing, they were prosperous. Also, they lived a long way from the Sidonians and had no relationship with anyone else.

18.zh: 五人回到琐拉和以实陶，见他们的弟兄；弟兄问他们说：你们有甚么话？
18.en: When they returned to Zorah and Eshtaol, their brothers asked them, "How did you find things?"

18.zh: 他们回答说：起来，我们上去攻击他们罢！我们已经窥探那地，见那地甚好。你们为何静坐不动呢？要急速前往得那地为业，不可迟延。
18.en: They answered, "Come on, let's attack them! We have seen that the land is very good. Aren't you going to do something? Don't hesitate to go there and take it over.

18.zh: 你们到了那里，必看见安居无虑的民，地也宽阔。 □ 神已将那地交在你们手中；那地百物俱全，一无所缺。
18.en: When you get there, you will find an unsuspecting people and a spacious land that God has put into your hands, a land that lacks nothing whatever."

18.zh: 于是但族中的六百人，各带兵器，从琐拉和以实陶前往，
18.en: Then six hundred men from the clan of the Danites, armed for battle, set out from Zorah and Eshtaol.

18.zh: 上到犹大的基列耶琳，在基列耶琳后边安营。因此那地方名叫玛哈尼但，直到今日。
18.en: On their way they set up camp near Kiriath Jearim in Judah. This is why the place west of Kiriath Jearim is called Mahaneh Dan to this day.

18.zh: 他们从那里往以法莲山地去，来到米迦的住宅。
18.en: From there they went on to the hill country of Ephraim and came to Micah's house.

18.zh: 从前窥探拉亿地的五个人对他们的弟兄说：这宅子里有以弗得和家中的神像，并雕刻的像与铸成的像，你们知道么？现在你们要想一想当怎样行。
18.en: Then the five men who had spied out the land of Laish said to their brothers, "Do you know that one of these houses has an ephod, other household gods, a carved image and a cast idol? Now you know what to do."

18.zh: 五人就进入米迦的住宅，到了那少年利未人的房内问他好。
18.en: So they turned in there and went to the house of the young Levite at Micah's place and greeted him.

18.zh: 那六百但人各带兵器，站在门口。
18.en: The six hundred Danites, armed for battle, stood at the entrance to the gate.

18.zh: 窥探地的五个人走进去，将雕刻的像 、 以弗得 、 家中的神像，并铸成的像，都拿了去。祭司和带兵器的六百人，一同站在门口。
18.en: The five men who had spied out the land went inside and took the carved image, the ephod, the other household gods and the cast idol while the priest and the six hundred armed men stood at the entrance to the gate.

18.zh: 那五个人进入米迦的住宅，拿出雕刻的像 、 以弗得 、 家中的神像，并铸成的像，祭司就问他们说：你们做甚么呢？
18.en: When these men went into Micah's house and took the carved image, the ephod, the other household gods and the cast idol, the priest said to them, "What are you doing?"

18.zh: 他们回答说：不要作声，用手摀口，跟我们去罢！我们必以你为父 、 为祭司。你作一家的祭司好呢？还是作以色列一族一支派的祭司好呢？
18.en: They answered him, "Be quiet! Don't say a word. Come with us, and be our father and priest. Isn't it better that you serve a tribe and clan in Israel as priest rather than just one man's household?"

18.zh: 祭司心里喜悦，便拿著以弗得和家中的神像，并雕刻的像，进入他们中间。
18.en: Then the priest was glad. He took the ephod, the other household gods and the carved image and went along with the people.

18.zh: 他们就转身离开那里，妻子 、 儿女 、 牲畜 、 财物都在前头。
18.en: Putting their little children, their livestock and their possessions in front of them, they turned away and left.

18.zh: 离米迦的住宅已远，米迦的近邻都聚集来，追赶但人，
18.en: When they had gone some distance from Micah's house, the men who lived near Micah were called together and overtook the Danites.

18.zh: 呼叫但人。但人回头问米迦说：你聚集这许多人来做甚么呢？
18.en: As they shouted after them, the Danites turned and said to Micah, "What's the matter with you that you called out your men to fight?"

18.zh: 米迦说：你们将我所做的神像和祭司都带了去，我还有所剩的么？怎么还问我说做甚么呢？
18.en: He replied, "You took the gods I made, and my priest, and went away. What else do I have? How can you ask, 'What's the matter with you?' "

18.zh: 但人对米迦说：你不要使我们听见你的声音，恐怕有性暴的人攻击你，以致你和你的全家尽都丧命。
18.en: The Danites answered, "Don't argue with us, or some hot-tempered men will attack you, and you and your family will lose your lives."

18.zh: 但人还是走他们的路。米迦见他们的势力比自己强盛，就转身回家去了。
18.en: So the Danites went their way, and Micah, seeing that they were too strong for him, turned around and went back home.

18.zh: 但人将米迦所做的神像和他的祭司都带到拉亿，见安居无虑的民，就用刀杀了那民，又放火烧了那城，
18.en: Then they took what Micah had made, and his priest, and went on to Laish, against a peaceful and unsuspecting people. They attacked them with the sword and burned down their city.

18.zh: 并无人搭救；因为离西顿远，他们又与别人没有来往。城在平原，那平原靠近伯利合。但人又在那里修城居住，
18.en: There was no one to rescue them because they lived a long way from Sidon and had no relationship with anyone else. The city was in a valley near Beth Rehob. The Danites rebuilt the city and settled there.

18.zh: 照著他们始祖以色列之子但的名字，给那城起名叫但；原先那城名叫拉亿。
18.en: They named it Dan after their forefather Dan, who was born to Israel-though the city used to be called Laish.

18.zh: 但人就为自己设立那雕刻的像。摩西的孙子 、 革舜的儿子约拿单，和他的子孙作但支派的祭司，直到那地遭掳掠的日子。
18.en: There the Danites set up for themselves the idols, and Jonathan son of Gershom, the son of Moses, and his sons were priests for the tribe of Dan until the time of the captivity of the land.

18.zh: 神的殿在示罗多少日子，但人为自己设立米迦所雕刻的像也在但多少日子。
18.en: They continued to use the idols Micah had made, all the time the house of God was in Shiloh.

19.zh: 当以色列中没有王的时候，有住以法莲山地那边的一个利未人，娶了一个犹大伯利恒的女子为妾。
19.en: In those days Israel had no king.Now a Levite who lived in a remote area in the hill country of Ephraim took a concubine from Bethlehem in Judah.

19.zh: 妾行淫离开丈夫，回犹大的伯利恒，到了父家，在那里住了四个月。
19.en: But she was unfaithful to him. She left him and went back to her father's house in Bethlehem, Judah. After she had been there four months,

19.zh: 他丈夫起来，带著一个仆人 、 两匹驴去见他，用好话劝他回来。女子就引丈夫进入父家。他父见了那人，便欢欢喜喜地迎接。
19.en: her husband went to her to persuade her to return. He had with him his servant and two donkeys. She took him into her father's house, and when her father saw him, he gladly welcomed him.

19.zh: 那人的岳父，就是女子的父亲，将那人留下住了三天。于是二人一同吃喝 、 住宿。
19.en: His father-in-law, the girl's father, prevailed upon him to stay; so he remained with him three days, eating and drinking, and sleeping there.

19.zh: 到第四天，利未人清早起来要走，女子的父亲对女婿说：请你吃点饭，加添心力，然后可以行路。
19.en: On the fourth day they got up early and he prepared to leave, but the girl's father said to his son -in-law, "Refresh yourself with something to eat; then you can go."

19.zh: 于是二人坐下一同吃喝。女子的父亲对那人说：请你再住一夜，畅快你的心。
19.en: So the two of them sat down to eat and drink together. Afterward the girl's father said, "Please stay tonight and enjoy yourself."

19.zh: 那人起来要走，他岳父强留他，他又住了一宿。
19.en: And when the man got up to go, his father-in-law persuaded him, so he stayed there that night.

19.zh: 到第五天，他清早起来要走，女子的父亲说：请你吃点饭，加添心力，等到日头偏西再走。于是二人一同吃饭。
19.en: On the morning of the fifth day, when he rose to go, the girl's father said, "Refresh yourself. Wait till afternoon!" So the two of them ate together.

19.zh: 那人同他的妾和仆人起来要走，他岳父，就是女子的父亲，对他说：看哪，日头偏西了，请你再住一夜；天快晚了，可以在这里住宿，畅快你的心。明天早早起行回家去。
19.en: Then when the man, with his concubine and his servant, got up to leave, his father-in-law, the girl's father, said, "Now look, it's almost evening. Spend the night here; the day is nearly over. Stay and enjoy yourself. Early tomorrow morning you can get up and be on your way home."

19.zh: 那人不愿再住一夜，就备上那两匹驴，带著妾起身走了，来到耶布斯的对面（耶布斯就是耶路撒冷。）
19.en: But, unwilling to stay another night, the man left and went toward Jebus (that is, Jerusalem), with his two saddled donkeys and his concubine.

19.zh: 临近耶布斯的时候，日头快要落了，仆人对主人说：我们不如进这耶布斯人的城里住宿。
19.en: When they were near Jebus and the day was almost gone, the servant said to his master, "Come, let's stop at this city of the Jebusites and spend the night."

19.zh: 主人回答说：我们不可进不是以色列人住的外邦城，不如过到基比亚去；
19.en: His master replied, "No. We won't go into an alien city, whose people are not Israelites. We will go on to Gibeah."

19.zh: 又对仆人说：我们可以到一个地方，或住在基比亚，或住在拉玛。
19.en: He added, "Come, let's try to reach Gibeah or Ramah and spend the night in one of those places."

19.zh: 他们就往前走。将到便雅悯的基比亚，日头已经落了；
19.en: So they went on, and the sun set as they neared Gibeah in Benjamin.

19.zh: 他们进入基比亚要在那里住宿，就坐在城里的街上，因为无人接他们进家住宿。
19.en: There they stopped to spend the night. They went and sat in the city square, but no one took them into his home for the night.

19.zh: 晚上，有一个老年人从田间做工回来。他原是以法莲山地的人，住在基比亚；那地方的人却是便雅悯人。
19.en: That evening an old man from the hill country of Ephraim, who was living in Gibeah (the men of the place were Benjamites), came in from his work in the fields.

19.zh: 老年人举目看见客人坐在城里的街上，就问他说：你从哪里来？要往哪里去？
19.en: When he looked and saw the traveler in the city square, the old man asked, "Where are you going? Where did you come from?"

19.zh: 他回答说：我们从犹大的伯利恒来，要往以法莲山地那边去。我原是那里的人，到过犹大的伯利恒，现在我往耶和华的殿去，在这里无人接我进他的家。
19.en: He answered, "We are on our way from Bethlehem in Judah to a remote area in the hill country of Ephraim where I live. I have been to Bethlehem in Judah and now I am going to the house of the LORD . No one has taken me into his house.

19.zh: 其实我有粮草可以喂驴，我与我的妾，并我的仆人，有饼有酒，并不缺少甚么。
19.en: We have both straw and fodder for our donkeys and bread and wine for ourselves your servants-me, your maidservant, and the young man with us. We don't need anything."

19.zh: 老年人说：愿你平安！你所需用的我都给你，只是不可在街上过夜。
19.en: "You are welcome at my house," the old man said. "Let me supply whatever you need. Only don't spend the night in the square."

19.zh: 于是领他们到家里，喂上驴，他们就洗脚吃喝。
19.en: So he took him into his house and fed his donkeys. After they had washed their feet, they had something to eat and drink.

19.zh: 他们心里正欢畅的时候，城中的匪徒围住房子，连连叩门，对房主老人说：你把那进你家的人带出来，我们要与他交合。
19.en: While they were enjoying themselves, some of the wicked men of the city surrounded the house. Pounding on the door, they shouted to the old man who owned the house, "Bring out the man who came to your house so we can have sex with him."

19.zh: 那房主出来对他们说：弟兄们哪，不要这样作恶；这人既然进了我的家，你们就不要行这丑事。
19.en: The owner of the house went outside and said to them, "No, my friends, don't be so vile. Since this man is my guest, don't do this disgraceful thing.

19.zh: 我有个女儿，还是处女，并有这人的妾，我将他们领出来任凭你们玷辱他们，只是向这人不可行这样的丑事。
19.en: Look, here is my virgin daughter, and his concubine. I will bring them out to you now, and you can use them and do to them whatever you wish. But to this man, don't do such a disgraceful thing."

19.zh: 那些人却不听从他的话。那人就把他的妾拉出去交给他们，他们便与他交合，终夜凌辱他，直到天色快亮才放他去。
19.en: But the men would not listen to him. So the man took his concubine and sent her outside to them, and they raped her and abused her throughout the night, and at dawn they let her go.

19.zh: 天快亮的时候，妇人回到他主人住宿的房门前，就仆倒在地，直到天亮。
19.en: At daybreak the woman went back to the house where her master was staying, fell down at the door and lay there until daylight.

19.zh: 早晨，他的主人起来开了房门，出去要行路，不料那妇人仆倒在房门前，两手搭在门槛上；
19.en: When her master got up in the morning and opened the door of the house and stepped out to continue on his way, there lay his concubine, fallen in the doorway of the house, with her hands on the threshold.

19.zh: 就对妇人说：起来，我们走罢！妇人却不回答。那人便将他驮在驴上，起身回本处去了。
19.en: He said to her, "Get up; let's go." But there was no answer. Then the man put her on his donkey and set out for home.

19.zh: 到了家里，用刀将妾的尸身切成十二块，使人拿著传送以色列的四境。
19.en: When he reached home, he took a knife and cut up his concubine, limb by limb, into twelve parts and sent them into all the areas of Israel.

19.zh: 凡看见的人都说：从以色列人出埃及地，直到今日，这样的事没有行过，也没有见过。现在应当思想，大家商议当怎样办理。
19.en: Everyone who saw it said, "Such a thing has never been seen or done, not since the day the Israelites came up out of Egypt. Think about it! Consider it! Tell us what to do!"

20.zh: 于是以色列从但到别是巴，以及住基列地的众人都出来，如同一人，聚集在米斯巴耶和华面前。
20.en: Then all the Israelites from Dan to Beersheba and from the land of Gilead came out as one man and assembled before the LORD in Mizpah.

20.zh: 以色列民的首领，就是各支派的军长，都站在神百姓的会中；拿刀的步兵共有四十万。
20.en: The leaders of all the people of the tribes of Israel took their places in the assembly of the people of God, four hundred thousand soldiers armed with swords.

20.zh: 以色列人上到米斯巴，便雅悯人都听见了。以色列人说：请你将这件恶事的情由对我们说明。
20.en: (The Benjamites heard that the Israelites had gone up to Mizpah.) Then the Israelites said, "Tell us how this awful thing happened."

20.zh: 那利未人，就是被害之妇人的丈夫，回答说：我和我的妾到了便雅悯的基比亚住宿。
20.en: So the Levite, the husband of the murdered woman, said, "I and my concubine came to Gibeah in Benjamin to spend the night.

20.zh: 基比亚人夜间起来，围了我住的房子，想要杀我，又将我的妾强奸致死。
20.en: During the night the men of Gibeah came after me and surrounded the house, intending to kill me. They raped my concubine, and she died.

20.zh: 我就把我妾的尸身切成块子，使人拿著传送以色列得为业的全地，因为基比亚人在以色列中行了扔菏丑恶的事。
20.en: I took my concubine, cut her into pieces and sent one piece to each region of Israel's inheritance, because they committed this lewd and disgraceful act in Israel.

20.zh: 你们以色列人都当筹划商议。
20.en: Now, all you Israelites, speak up and give your verdict."

20.zh: 众民都起来如同一人，说：我们连一人都不回自己帐棚 、 自己房屋去。
20.en: All the people rose as one man, saying, "None of us will go home. No, not one of us will return to his house.

20.zh: 我们向基比亚人必这样行，照所掣的签去攻击他们。
20.en: But now this is what we'll do to Gibeah: We'll go up against it as the lot directs.

20.zh: 我们要在以色列各支派中，一百人挑取十人，一千人挑取百人，一万人挑取千人，为民运粮，等大众到了便雅悯的基比亚，就照基比亚人在以色列中所行的丑事征伐他们。
20.en: We'll take ten men out of every hundred from all the tribes of Israel, and a hundred from a thousand, and a thousand from ten thousand, to get provisions for the army. Then, when the army arrives at Gibeah in Benjamin, it can give them what they deserve for all this vileness done in Israel."

20.zh: 于是以色列众人彼此连合如同一人，聚集攻击那城
20.en: So all the men of Israel got together and united as one man against the city.

20.zh: 以色列众支派打发人去，问便雅悯支派的各家说：你们中间怎么做了这样的恶事呢？
20.en: The tribes of Israel sent men throughout the tribe of Benjamin, saying, "What about this awful crime that was committed among you?

20.zh: 现在你们要将基比亚的那些匪徒交出来，我们好治死他们，从以色列中除掉这恶。便雅悯人却不肯听从他们弟兄以色列人的话。
20.en: Now surrender those wicked men of Gibeah so that we may put them to death and purge the evil from Israel." But the Benjamites would not listen to their fellow Israelites.

20.zh: 便雅悯人从他们的各城里出来，聚集到了基比亚，要与以色列人打仗。
20.en: From their towns they came together at Gibeah to fight against the Israelites.

20.zh: 那时便雅悯人从各城里点出拿刀的，共有二万六千；另外还有基比亚人点出七百精兵。
20.en: At once the Benjamites mobilized twenty-six thousand swordsmen from their towns, in addition to seven hundred chosen men from those living in Gibeah.

20.zh: 在众军之中有拣选的七百精兵，都是左手便利的，能用机弦甩石打人，毫发不差。
20.en: Among all these soldiers there were seven hundred chosen men who were left-handed, each of whom could sling a stone at a hair and not miss.

20.zh: 便雅悯人之外，点出以色列人拿刀的，共有四十万，都是战士。
20.en: Israel, apart from Benjamin, mustered four hundred thousand swordsmen, all of them fighting men.

20.zh: 以色列人就起来，到伯特利去求问神说：我们中间谁当首先上去与便雅悯人争战呢？耶和华说：犹大当先上去。
20.en: The Israelites went up to Bethel and inquired of God. They said, "Who of us shall go first to fight against the Benjamites?" The LORD replied, "Judah shall go first."

20.zh: 以色列人早晨起来，对著基比亚安营。
20.en: The next morning the Israelites got up and pitched camp near Gibeah.

20.zh: 以色列人出来，要与便雅悯人打仗，就在基比亚前摆阵。
20.en: The men of Israel went out to fight the Benjamites and took up battle positions against them at Gibeah.

20.zh: 便雅悯人就从基比亚出来，当日杀死以色列人二万二千。
20.en: The Benjamites came out of Gibeah and cut down twenty-two thousand Israelites on the battlefield that day.

20.zh: 以色列人彼此奋勇，仍在头一日摆阵的地方又摆阵。
20.en: But the men of Israel encouraged one another and again took up their positions where they had stationed themselves the first day.

20.zh: 未摆阵之先，以色列人上去，在耶和华面前哭号，直到晚上，求问耶和华说：我们再去与我们弟兄便雅悯人打仗可以不可以？耶和华说：可以上去攻击他们。
20.en: The Israelites went up and wept before the LORD until evening, and they inquired of the LORD . They said, "Shall we go up again to battle against the Benjamites, our brothers?" The LORD answered, "Go up against them."

20.zh: 第二日，以色列人就上前攻击便雅悯人。
20.en: Then the Israelites drew near to Benjamin the second day.

20.zh: 便雅悯人也在这日从基比亚出来，与以色列人接战，又杀死他们一万八千，都是拿刀的。
20.en: This time, when the Benjamites came out from Gibeah to oppose them, they cut down another eighteen thousand Israelites, all of them armed with swords.

20.zh: 以色列众人就上到伯特利，坐在耶和华面前哭号，当日禁食直到晚上；又在耶和华面前献燔祭和平安祭。
20.en: Then the Israelites, all the people, went up to Bethel, and there they sat weeping before the LORD . They fasted that day until evening and presented burnt offerings and fellowship offerings to the LORD .

20.zh: 那时，神的约柜在那里；亚伦的孙子 、 以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈侍立在约柜前。以色列人问耶和华说：我们当再出去与我们弟兄便雅悯人打仗呢？还是罢兵呢？耶和华说：你们当上去，因为明日我必将他们交在你们手中。
20.en: And the Israelites inquired of the LORD . (In those days the ark of the covenant of God was there,

20.zh: a
20.en: with Phinehas son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, ministering before it.) They asked, "Shall we go up again to battle with Benjamin our brother, or not?" The LORD responded, "Go, for tomorrow I will give them into your hands."

20.zh: 以色列人在基比亚的四围设下伏兵。
20.en: Then Israel set an ambush around Gibeah.

20.zh: 第三日，以色列人又上去攻击便雅悯人，在基比亚前摆阵，与前两次一样。
20.en: They went up against the Benjamites on the third day and took up positions against Gibeah as they had done before.

20.zh: 便雅悯人也出来迎敌，就被引诱离城；在田间两条路上，一通伯特利，一通基比亚，像前两次，动手杀死以色列人约有三十个。
20.en: The Benjamites came out to meet them and were drawn away from the city. They began to inflict casualties on the Israelites as before, so that about thirty men fell in the open field and on the roads-the one leading to Bethel and the other to Gibeah.

20.zh: 便雅悯人说：他们仍旧败在我们面前。但以色列人说：我们不如逃跑，引诱他们离开城到路上来。
20.en: While the Benjamites were saying, "We are defeating them as before," the Israelites were saying, "Let's retreat and draw them away from the city to the roads."

20.zh: 以色列众人都起来，在巴力他玛摆阵，以色列的伏兵从马利迦巴埋伏的地方冲上前去。
20.en: All the men of Israel moved from their places and took up positions at Baal Tamar, and the Israelite ambush charged out of its place on the west of Gibeah.

20.zh: 有以色列人中的一万精兵，来到基比亚前接战，势派甚是凶猛；便雅悯人却不知道灾祸临近了。
20.en: Then ten thousand of Israel's finest men made a frontal attack on Gibeah. The fighting was so heavy that the Benjamites did not realize how near disaster was.

20.zh: 耶和华使以色列人杀败便雅悯人。那日，以色列人杀死便雅悯人二万五千一百，都是拿刀的。
20.en: The LORD defeated Benjamin before Israel, and on that day the Israelites struck down 25,100 Benjamites, all armed with swords.

20.zh: 于是便雅悯人知道自己败了。先是以色列人；因为靠著在基比亚前所设的伏兵，就在便雅悯人面前诈败。
20.en: Then the Benjamites saw that they were beaten. Now the men of Israel had given way before Benjamin, because they relied on the ambush they had set near Gibeah.

20.zh: 伏兵急忙闯进基比亚，用刀杀死全城的人。
20.en: The men who had been in ambush made a sudden dash into Gibeah, spread out and put the whole city to the sword.

20.zh: 以色列人预先同伏兵约定在城内放火，以烟气上腾为号。
20.en: The men of Israel had arranged with the ambush that they should send up a great cloud of smoke from the city,

20.zh: 以色列人临退阵的时候，便雅悯人动手杀死以色列人，约有三十个，就说：他们仍像前次被我们杀败了。
20.en: and then the men of Israel would turn in the battle. The Benjamites had begun to inflict casualties on the men of Israel (about thirty), and they said, "We are defeating them as in the first battle."

20.zh: 当烟气如柱从城中上腾的时候，便雅悯人回头观看，见全城的烟气冲天。
20.en: But when the column of smoke began to rise from the city, the Benjamites turned and saw the smoke of the whole city going up into the sky.

20.zh: 以色列人又转身回来，便雅悯人就甚惊惶，因为看见灾祸临到自己了。
20.en: Then the men of Israel turned on them, and the men of Benjamin were terrified, because they realized that disaster had come upon them.

20.zh: 他们在以色列人面前转身往旷野逃跑；以色列人在后面追杀。那从各城里出来的，也都夹攻杀灭他们。
20.en: So they fled before the Israelites in the direction of the desert, but they could not escape the battle. And the men of Israel who came out of the towns cut them down there.

20.zh: 以色列人围绕便雅悯人，追赶他们，在他们歇脚之处 、 对著日出之地的基比亚践踏他们。
20.en: They surrounded the Benjamites, chased them and easily overran them in the vicinity of Gibeah on the east.

20.zh: 便雅悯人死了的有一万八千，都是勇士。
20.en: Eighteen thousand Benjamites fell, all of them valiant fighters.

20.zh: 其余的人转身向旷野逃跑，往临门磐去。以色列人在道路上杀了他们五千人，如拾取遗穗一样，追到基顿又杀了他们二千人。
20.en: As they turned and fled toward the desert to the rock of Rimmon, the Israelites cut down five thousand men along the roads. They kept pressing after the Benjamites as far as Gidom and struck down two thousand more.

20.zh: 那日便雅悯死了的共有二万五千人，都是拿刀的勇士。
20.en: On that day twenty-five thousand Benjamite swordsmen fell, all of them valiant fighters.

20.zh: 只剩下六百人，转身向旷野逃跑，到了临门磐，就在那里住了四个月。
20.en: But six hundred men turned and fled into the desert to the rock of Rimmon, where they stayed four months.

20.zh: 以色列人又转到便雅悯地，将各城的人和牲畜，并一切所遇见的，都用刀杀尽，又放火烧了一切城邑。
20.en: The men of Israel went back to Benjamin and put all the towns to the sword, including the animals and everything else they found. All the towns they came across they set on fire.

21.zh: 以色列人在米斯巴曾起誓说：我们都不将女儿给便雅悯人为妻。
21.en: The men of Israel had taken an oath at Mizpah: "Not one of us will give his daughter in marriage to a Benjamite."

21.zh: 以色列人来到伯特利，坐在神面前直到晚上，放声痛哭，
21.en: The people went to Bethel, where they sat before God until evening, raising their voices and weeping bitterly.

21.zh: 说：耶和华 ─ 以色列的神啊，为何以色列中有这样缺了一支派的事呢？
21.en: "O LORD , the God of Israel," they cried, "why has this happened to Israel? Why should one tribe be missing from Israel today?"

21.zh: 次日清早，百姓起来，在那里筑了一座坛，献燔祭和平安祭。
21.en: Early the next day the people built an altar and presented burnt offerings and fellowship offerings.

21.zh: 以色列人彼此问说：以色列各支派中，谁没有同会众上到耶和华面前来呢？先是以色列人起过大誓说，凡不上米斯巴到耶和华面前来的，必将他治死。
21.en: Then the Israelites asked, "Who from all the tribes of Israel has failed to assemble before the LORD ?" For they had taken a solemn oath that anyone who failed to assemble before the LORD at Mizpah should certainly be put to death.

21.zh: 以色列人为他们的弟兄便雅悯后悔，说：如今以色列中绝了一个支派了。
21.en: Now the Israelites grieved for their brothers, the Benjamites. "Today one tribe is cut off from Israel," they said.

21.zh: 我们既在耶和华面前起誓说，必不将我们的女儿给便雅悯人为妻，现在我们当怎样办理 、 使他们剩下的人有妻呢？
21.en: "How can we provide wives for those who are left, since we have taken an oath by the LORD not to give them any of our daughters in marriage?"

21.zh: 又彼此问说：以色列支派中谁没有上米斯巴到耶和华面前来呢？他们就查出基列雅比没有一人进营到会众那里；
21.en: Then they asked, "Which one of the tribes of Israel failed to assemble before the LORD at Mizpah?" They discovered that no one from Jabesh Gilead had come to the camp for the assembly.

21.zh: 因为百姓被数的时候，没有一个基列雅比人在那里。
21.en: For when they counted the people, they found that none of the people of Jabesh Gilead were there.

21.zh: 会众就打发一万二千大勇士，吩咐他们说：你们去用刀将基列雅比人连妇女带孩子都击杀了。
21.en: So the assembly sent twelve thousand fighting men with instructions to go to Jabesh Gilead and put to the sword those living there, including the women and children.

21.zh: 所当行的就是这样：要将一切男子和已嫁的女子尽行杀戮。
21.en: "This is what you are to do," they said. "Kill every male and every woman who is not a virgin."

21.zh: 他们在基列雅比人中，遇见了四百个未嫁的处女，就带到迦南地的示罗营里。
21.en: They found among the people living in Jabesh Gilead four hundred young women who had never slept with a man, and they took them to the camp at Shiloh in Canaan.

21.zh: 全会众打发人到临门磐的便雅悯人那里，向他们说和睦的话。
21.en: Then the whole assembly sent an offer of peace to the Benjamites at the rock of Rimmon.

21.zh: 当时便雅悯人回来了，以色列人就把所存活基列雅比的女子给他们为妻，还是不够。
21.en: So the Benjamites returned at that time and were given the women of Jabesh Gilead who had been spared. But there were not enough for all of them.

21.zh: 百姓为便雅悯人后悔，因为耶和华使以色列人缺了一个支派（原文是使以色列中有了破口）。
21.en: The people grieved for Benjamin, because the LORD had made a gap in the tribes of Israel.

21.zh: 会中的长老说：便雅悯中的女子既然除灭了，我们当怎样办理 、 使那余剩的人有妻呢？
21.en: And the elders of the assembly said, "With the women of Benjamin destroyed, how shall we provide wives for the men who are left?

21.zh: 又说：便雅悯逃脱的人当有地业，免得以色列中涂抹了一个支派。
21.en: The Benjamite survivors must have heirs," they said, "so that a tribe of Israel will not be wiped out.

21.zh: 只是我们不能将自己的女儿给他们为妻；因为以色列人曾起誓说，有将女儿给便雅悯人为妻的，必受咒诅。
21.en: We can't give them our daughters as wives, since we Israelites have taken this oath: 'Cursed be anyone who gives a wife to a Benjamite.'

21.zh: 他们又说：在利波拿以南，伯特利以北，在示剑大路以东的示罗，年年有耶和华的节期；
21.en: But look, there is the annual festival of the LORD in Shiloh, to the north of Bethel, and east of the road that goes from Bethel to Shechem, and to the south of Lebonah."

21.zh: 就吩咐便雅悯人说：你们去，在葡萄园中埋伏。
21.en: So they instructed the Benjamites, saying, "Go and hide in the vineyards

21.zh: 若看见示罗的女子出来跳舞，就从葡萄园出来，在示罗的女子中各抢一个为妻，回便雅悯地去。
21.en: and watch. When the girls of Shiloh come out to join in the dancing, then rush from the vineyards and each of you seize a wife from the girls of Shiloh and go to the land of Benjamin.

21.zh: 他们的父亲或是弟兄若来与我们争竞，我们就说：求你们看我们的情面，施恩给这些人，因我们在争战的时候没有给他们留下女子为妻。这也不是你们将子女给他们的；若是你们给的，就算有罪。
21.en: When their fathers or brothers complain to us, we will say to them, 'Do us a kindness by helping them, because we did not get wives for them during the war, and you are innocent, since you did not give your daughters to them.' "

21.zh: 于是便雅悯人照样而行，按著他们的数目从跳舞的女子中抢去为妻，就回自己的地业去，又重修城邑居住。
21.en: So that is what the Benjamites did. While the girls were dancing, each man caught one and carried her off to be his wife. Then they returned to their inheritance and rebuilt the towns and settled in them.

21.zh: 当时以色列人离开那里，各归本支派 、 本宗族 、 本地业去了。
21.en: At that time the Israelites left that place and went home to their tribes and clans, each to his own inheritance.

21.zh: 那时，以色列中没有王，各人任意而行。
